Added `Encode(w io.Writer) error` and `Decode(r io.Reader) error` to [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/shapeindex.go#L1602-L1904) on branch `shape-index-encode-decode`.

### Summary of Changes
- **`ShapeIndex` Serialization ([`s2/shapeindex.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/shapeindex.go#L1602-L2025))**:
  - `Encode` triggers `Build()` to ensure pending updates are applied before writing index parameters, shape entries (including `nil` placeholders so shape IDs are preserved), and the full spatial cell structure (`cells`, `cellMap`, `clippedShape`s, `containsCenter`, and `edges`).
  - `Decode` reconstructs all shapes and the complete cell structure with `status = fresh` so queries and iterators work immediately without requiring `Build()`.
  - Added validation and allocation limits for shape counts, cell counts, vertex counts, and ID bounds to return errors rather than panicking on truncated, corrupted, or oversized inputs.
- **Built-in `Shape` Encoding Support**:
  - Added `Encode` and `Decode` methods to [`PointVector`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/point_vector.go#L48-L102), [`LaxPolyline`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/lax_polyline.go#L60-L118), [`LaxPolygon`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/lax_polygon.go#L228-L338), and [`LaxLoop`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/lax_loop.go#L92-L151), plus fallback generic shape encoding for custom in-package `Shape` implementations.
  - Fixed [`Polyline.decode`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/polyline.go#L381) to accept `*decoder` so read errors propagate properly, and fixed chain/edge indexing bugs in [`LaxPolygon.ChainPosition`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/lax_polygon.go#L211-L226), [`LaxLoop.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/lax_loop.go#L74-L80), [`PointVector.ChainEdge`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/point_vector.go#L36), and [`ShapeIndex`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/shapeindex.go#L850) when shape IDs contain gaps.
- **Tests ([`s2/shapeindex_test.go`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4y2ya0ba/s2/shapeindex_test.go#L575-L1157))**:
  - Added unit and fuzz tests covering empty indexes, unbuilt indexes, all built-in shape types (including zero-edge shapes and mixed chain counts), removed shapes with ID gaps, post-decode queries, and malformed/truncated/oversized inputs.
